item.title: CARROLL: Outdated and Useless
item.description: You know what they say: “Deaths always happen in threes.”

item.title: Rivian lands investment of up to $1.25 billion from Uber for driverless vehicles
item.description: Electric vehicle (EV) company Rivian has landed an investment of up to $1.25 billion from the ridesharing company Uber for the production of driverless robotaxis. The deal was announced via a news release from Rivian last Thursday, which outlined the specifics of the seven-figure investment.

item.title: One year after his death, loved ones remember Justin Etienne
item.description: A sunset skyline filled with balloons. Candles arranged in the shape of a heart. T-shirts adorned with the words “forever loved.” This was the makeup of Denny Dobbs Park on the evening of March 19, as family and friends gathered to remember Justin Etienne one year after his death.

item.title: Commissioners hear update on JDA, Stanton Springs
item.description: The Newton County Board of Commissioners heard an update on the Joint Development Authority (JDA) of Newton, Jasper, Morgan and Walton Counties at their regular meeting on March 17.

item.title: Redskins salvage series with Friday wins over Putnam County
item.description: After dropping the series opener on their home field, Social Circle made the most of its opportunities on Friday as it won both games of a region doubleheader over Putnam County. Even in the game one loss, the ‘Skins found ways to put up big numbers at the plate in every game of the series.

item.title: Eastside Eagles earn top 10 finishes at Grayson Home Meet
item.description: The Eastside Eagles sent a large team to compete in the Grayson Home Meet No. 4, and the group left with a slew of top 10 finishes. In total, eight Eastside athletes finished inside the top 10 in their respective events.

item.title: Sixth person arrested in New Year’s shooting
item.description: The Newton County Sheriff’s Office (NCSO) has arrested a sixth individual connected to a shooting that happened at the Salem Road Circle K on New Year’s Day. An unnamed 16-year-old turned himself into custody on Monday for his alleged role in the shooting, according to the NCSO. It is not immediately clear what role the teenager may have played in the incident.

item.title: Peachtree Academy announces Class of 2026 valedictorian and salutatorian
item.description: Peachtree Academy has announced the Valedictorian and Salutatorian for the Class of 2026.

item.title: CHANCEY: God takes sin seriously! Do we?
item.description: We often downplay sin. We flirt with sin, rationalize sin, attempt to justify sin, rank sins, and possibly attempt to cover up sin. Yet God finds all sin offensive.

item.title: YARBROUGH: A eulogy to a friend and neighbor who made a difference
item.description: I received a note from a reader last week chiding me for writing about the Okefenokee so much and that he and others were tired of it. In fact, I have done only two columns on the Okefenokee this year, but I did allow mining proponents and opponents to express their positions on the subject. So that’s four columns total. Is that overkill?

item.title: Newton County Board of Education reviews FY27 budget outlook, approves employee pay adjustment
item.description: The Newton County Board of Education received an early look at its fiscal year 2027 budget and approved a one-time pay adjustment for employees during its regular session meeting on Tuesday, March 17.

item.title: Charika Davis’ request for additional street light denied
item.description: A request to place a street light on Stone Mountain Street in Covington was denied by a vote from the Covington City Council.
